title: 이어폰 한쪽
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop Punk. Distorted electric guitars play palm-muted eighth-note power chords in the verses, opening up to sustained chords in the chorus. A high-energy drum kit features a driving punk beat with a prominent snare on 2 and 4 and consistent eighth-note hi-hats. The bass guitar follows the root notes of the guitar progression with a picked attack. Male vocals are delivered with a melodic, youthful punk inflection. The tempo is 175 BPM in the key of E Major.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[distorted electric guitar power chords, driving punk drums]

[Verse 1]
[palm-muted guitar]
복싱을 시작한 지 두 달이에요
샌드백만 쳤어요
오늘 첫 스파링이에요
링에 올라갔어요 로프가 흔들려요
상대가 앞에서 있어요
글러브를 맞댔어요 시작

[Chorus]
[sustained guitar chords, crash cymbals]
잽이 왔어요 피했어요
원투가 왔어요 가드로 막았어요
어깨가 울렸어요 다시 잽
이번엔 못 피했어요 코에 맞았어요
뜨거워졌어요 코피가 났어요
입술로 흘러내려요
